title: LPIC-1 Foundations: Bash, Regex & Safe File Changes
purpose: Twelve offline unprivileged lessons: use Bash deliberately, search and transform text, edit/recover files and write small tested scripts. Recommended sequence, no unlocks. Completion is self-reviewed and unscored.
prerequisites: Navigation, ordinary file permissions and text/filter basics. Use the existing unprivileged image; no sudo or new packages. The first four lessons build the shell prerequisites for regex, editor and script work.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 partial 103.1, 103.3/104.7 reinforcement, 103.4, 103.7, 103.2 sed, 103.8, 105.1 environment/functions and 105.2 scripts. No full objectives, general Bash mastery, boot/rescue recovery, system profiles, mail, script suid, links/archives or privileged administration.
